title: Things To Do (for the weekend of September 12th)
description:
Looking for something to do in Los Angeles? From Philippine cultural celebrations and ocean conservation to island vibes, a pet parade, and historic traditions, here’s what’s happening near you.

FESTIVAL OF PHILIPPINE ARTS & CULTURE
Saturday, September 12 | 10:00 AM
Celebrate the spirit of community and togetherness at the 32nd annual Festival of Philippine Arts and Culture at Point Fermin Park in San Pedro. Come for the music, stay for the food, and enjoy a day of culture and connection.
🌐 FilAmArts.org

🌊 ALTASEA OPEN HOUSE
Saturday, September 12 | 10:00 AM
Head to the Port of L.A.’s innovation hub to learn about "Charting a Legacy of the Sea." Explore the deep connection between the ocean and the "blue" economy, showcasing solutions to tackle climate change and preserve our oceans.
🌐 AltaSea.org

🏝️ CARIBBEAN HERITAGE FESTIVAL
Saturday, September 12 | 2:00 PM
Experience the flavors, sounds, and island vibes of the Caribbean at Baldwin Hills/Crenshaw Plaza. This free celebration features local Caribbean and soul food restaurants, live entertainment, and a headline performance by Voice The Artiste.
🌐 CaribbeanHeritageFestivalLA.com

🐾 PICO UNION PET PARADE
Saturday, September 12 | 5:00 PM
Bring your four-legged friends to Alvarado Terrace Park to celebrate new doggy clean-up stations and services. The event features a pet parade, an animal resource fair, and a free movie night for the whole family.
🌐 CD1.LACity.gov — under Calendar section

EAST L.A. MEXICAN INDEPENDENCE DAY PARADE & FESTIVAL
Sunday, September 13 | Parade at 10:00 AM
Now in its 80th year, this cherished tradition brings generations together to honor Mexican heritage and community pride. Join local businesses, performers, and families for the parade at 10:00 AM, followed by the festival at 11:00 AM.
🌐 EastLA-Parade.com
